acid.name: Proton Pump Inhibitor (PPI)
acid.label: Acid
acid.description: Proton pump inhibitor. Strongly suppresses gastric acid secretion, raising intragastric pH.

amoxicillin.name: Amoxicillin – Penicillin Antibiotic
amoxicillin.label: Amoxicillin
amoxicillin.description: Penicillin-class antibiotic. Inhibits bacterial cell wall synthesis to eradicate H. pylori.

clarithromycin.name: Clarithromycin – Macrolide Antibiotic
clarithromycin.label: Clarithromycin
clarithromycin.description: Macrolide antibiotic. Inhibits bacterial protein synthesis to suppress infection.

barrier.name: Mucosal Protective Agent
barrier.label: Barrier
barrier.description: Protects gastric mucosa from gastric acid and peptic damage.

lacto.name: Lactobacillus (Probiotic)
lacto.label: Lactobacillus
lacto.description: Promotes beneficial gut flora and aids gastric mucosal healing.

pyloriStandard.name: Helicobacter pylori (Standard Strain)
pyloriStandard.description: Wild-type strain that produces urease to neutralize gastric acid and colonize the stomach.

scout.name: H. pylori Scout
scout.description: Fast-moving reconnaissance strain. Low HP and small reward.

urease.name: Urease Tank
urease.description: Heavy strain that releases urease to neutralize surrounding gastric acid.

cagA.name: CagA Sniper
cagA.description: Ranged strain that delivers CagA toxin to epithelial cells.

vacA.name: VacA Bomber
vacA.description: On death releases VacA toxin causing localized collapse (ulceration).
